name: Invoke the Keen Intellect
body:
Minimum Spell Level: 3rd.

You gain the benefits of a headband of vast intelligence +2, but the effects of your head slot item is suppressed unless you dedicate a 7th-level or higher spell slot to this invocation.
You can dedicate a 4th-level spell slot to increase this benefit to a +4, or a 6th-level spell slot to increase it to +6, but these effects suppress your head slot item unless you dedicate a spell slot at least 3 levels higher (7th and 9th, respectively).
